# Normalized mutual information

## Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(scabcd)
library(abcdutils)
library(here)
library(readr)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(webshot2)
library(rlist)


proc_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))

## Calculating NMIs for the min and mean p-value solutions of each nclust


#top_om_all <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_03_09_top_om_rows_all_nclust.csv"))
top_om_all <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_03_27_top_om_rows_all_nclust.csv"))

#data_list_train <- list.load(proc_path("2023_03_15_data_list_train.rdata"))
data_list_train <- list.load(proc_path("2023_03_27_data_list_0_train.rdata"))

for (row in seq_len(nrow(top_om_all))) {
    calc_nmi(top_om_all[row, ], data_list_train) |>
        gt() |>
        gt_theme_538() |>
        gtsave(fig_path(paste0(top_om_all[row, ]$"significance", "_nmis.png"),
                date = TRUE))
}
```
